name: @microsoft/winappcli
description: Windows App Development CLI and BuildTools utilities for Node.js native addon development

scripts.build: npm run build-cli && npm run generate-commands && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run compile
scripts.build-x64: dotnet publish ../winapp-CLI/WinApp.Cli/WinApp.Cli.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -o bin/win-x64 && pwsh -NoProfile -File ../winapp-devtools/build-devtools.ps1 -Configuration Release -Arch x64 -EngineOut bin/win-x64 -SkipNativeUnitTests
scripts.build-arm64: dotnet publish ../winapp-CLI/WinApp.Cli/WinApp.Cli.csproj -c Release -r win-arm64 --self-contained -o bin/win-arm64 && pwsh -NoProfile -File ../winapp-devtools/build-devtools.ps1 -Configuration Release -Arch arm64 -EngineOut bin/win-arm64 -SkipNativeUnitTests
scripts.build-copy-only: npm run copy-x64 && npm run copy-arm64
scripts.copy-x64: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = '../../artifacts/cli/win-x64'; const dest = 'bin/win-x64'; fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true});"
scripts.copy-arm64: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = '../../artifacts/cli/win-arm64'; const dest = 'bin/win-arm64'; fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true});"
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('bin', {recursive: true, force: true}); require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true});"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('\\n🎉 Windows App Development CLI installed successfully!\\n\\nGet started with: npx winapp --help\\n')"

author: Microsoft
